name: workspace-validation-capacity-lease
title: Serialize workspace-level validation capacity across stories
description: Prevent concurrent lattice validate and done_required_validate executions from different stories/worktrees from oversubscribing one machine and producing false member/suite timeout failures. Keep per-story evidence serialization, but add a canonical git-common-dir workspace capacity lease with heartbeat, stale recovery, reentrancy, explicit contention diagnostics, and no timeout-budget weakening.
